context:
Post-merge verification for PR #2757.

2026-10-09 tracker review: acceptance 1 and 3 were met by scheduled run 37928417334. Acceptance 2 was reworded to the 5-sample threshold. Acceptance 4 is new, from dispatch 37967682464. The throughput UAT job also has to move to nightly-v2 before dlv2-70 deletes nightly.yml; that is tracked by nightly-v2-throughput-uat-port-20261009, and the floor's history lookup in nightly.yml (about line 755) must follow it.

2026-10-22 survey of scheduled nightly.yml runs (read-only, nothing fixed): throughput-uat (the floor input) succeeded on every scheduled run from 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-15, six samples. throughput-uat-cedardb passed on 10-11 and failed on 10-12, 10-13, 10-14 and 10-15. In the 10-15 run (38720419880) the sweep reported phase exit codes preflight 0, execute 0, validate 1, report 0, and the later assert step still verified the result file (Throughput@Size 97833), so the job failed in the sweep's validate phase rather than in the throughput run; the validate output was not read. From 2026-10-16 to 2026-10-21 the scheduled nightly.yml runs contain no throughput jobs at all (jobs matching 'throughput' are absent), so no scheduled samples exist after 10-15, and every scheduled nightly-v2.yml run from 10-06 to 10-21 concluded failure. Not established: why the throughput jobs left nightly.yml, whether the floor left observe-only (six scheduled throughput-uat samples exist but the floor's own evaluation was not read), and the cause of the 10-12..10-15 validate failures or of the SSL eof in dispatch 37967682464.
description:

PR #2757 was merged after 2 green nightly cells with owner waiver. Monitor the scheduled runs to ensure the unquarantined CedarDB cell, statement timeouts, and numeric floor evaluate cleanly in production without false-positive ejection.

Status on 2026-10-09: scheduled run 37928417334 passed the CedarDB cell and uploaded artifacts throughput-uat-37928417334-1 and throughput-baseline-duckdb-tpch-sf1-37928417334-1 (acceptance 1 and 3). The floor is still observe-only: only 1 of the 5 required same-runner-class scheduled samples exists for amd-epyc-7763. Only scheduled runs count. A later manual dispatch, 37967682464, lost its CedarDB connection in all 3 streams with "SSL error: unexpected eof" (artifact throughput-uat-37967682464-1); the cause is not yet known.
